title: AICORE training v26 semantic lineage batch A
goal: Deep-read the core v26/v26.1/v26.2 training, smoke-test and rule-compliance scripts to extract historical mechanisms, experiments, failures and supersession constraints without treating the batch as full v26 semantic completion.
completion_test: Eight named training/evaluation scripts are read from Drive, source-derived findings are separated from inference, lineage/supersession is recorded, and a bounded semantic receipt is published with explicit unprocessed v26 remainder.
